purchase_motivation.primary: Show parents what the School Memories Album contains and how its pages are organized.
purchase_motivation.secondary: Present it as a colorful keepsake book for school records.
purchase_motivation.user_problem: School information and pictures need a single place to be recorded.
purchase_motivation.desired_change: Move from separate school details to one physical album.
purchase_motivation.why_buy: It offers preprinted pages for recording school details and photos.
risks: The motivation stays close to product description and does not clearly prioritize the multi-year benefit.

evidence: Page turns and readable fields show that the printed sections exist.
Many grade headings and prompt types are visible.
gaps: Exact complete grade range is not verified.
No child, parent, filled page or reaction.

evidence: Colorful cover and varied page designs.
gaps: No styled lifestyle or gift scene.

basis: Product identity and interior page types are clear.
The plan does not resolve whether the main sale is organization, long-term keepsake value or visual design.

hook_hypothesis.purchase_meaning: A colorful School Memories Album with pages to fill in.
hook_hypothesis.promise_created: The viewer will see what is inside the album.
hook_hypothesis.why_first: The cover is the cleanest identity shot and follows the normal product-introduction order.
hook_hypothesis.risk: It communicates what the product is before communicating why its multi-year structure matters.

required_proof.claim: The album includes grade-specific record pages.
required_proof.confirmation: Hold one early-grade and one later-grade page long enough to read

required_proof.claim: The album includes places for pictures and written details.
required_proof.action: Point to photo boxes and prompt lines
required_proof.result: Blank picture/drawing boxes and labeled fields are visible

information_state_plan.new_understanding: This is a colorful School Memories Album.
The album opens into school-year pages.
information_state_plan.delete_cost: Viewer may not understand the interior format.

information_state_plan.new_understanding: Early-grade pages include profile and activity prompts.
Pages include picture and drawing spaces.
information_state_plan.voice_or_caption_job: Call out photo and drawing areas.

information_state_plan.new_understanding: The album continues through later grade designs.
The complete album has a substantial, colorful page block.
information_state_plan.voice_or_caption_job: Summarize it as one complete school memory book.
information_state_plan.exit_when: Front cover and thickness are understood.

information_state_plan.voice_or_caption_job: Use a generic non-directional invitation to learn more.
information_state_plan.delete_cost: No explicit close, though evidence is unchanged.

hero_strategy.job: Finish on the cover and page thickness as a conventional complete-product summary.
hero_strategy.hold_or_exit_condition: Exit once cover and page volume are understood; avoid repeated rotations.
hero_strategy.fallback_if_missing: Use the clean front-cover state from S01.

cta_strategy.job: Use a soft, non-directional product-discovery line only.
cta_strategy.hold_or_exit_condition: Keep only long enough for a short line; no purchase-location language.
cta_strategy.fallback_if_missing: End without a CTA on the clean cover Hero.

fallback.trigger: Later-grade headings or detailed fields are not readable enough for the planned sequence.
fallback.replacement_plan: Shorten to cover, one early-grade spread, one photo/prompt detail and product Hero.
reshoot_needs: Clean wide shot showing separated grade sections
Filled sample page if real and authorized

baseline_characterization: A competent feature tour organized primarily by product reveal and page chronology. It recognizes record-page utility but does not make the early-to-late school-year meaning the opening decision.
